title: Initial Data for Physical Late-Time Schwarzschild Wave Tails
exact_target: Identify isolated-system wave data that give physically meaningful late-time radiation tails on a Schwarzschild background.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004808 (OWR-8415343-011). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/40, pp. 2157--2267. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The meaning of physically realistic data is itself a requested characterization; it is not replaced by an arbitrary compact-support hypothesis.
